name_ar: منهجية مؤشرات داو جونز للسوق الإسلامية — S&P Dow Jones Indices (مسودة معطّلة، غير مشفّرة)
name_en: Dow Jones Islamic Market Indices Methodology — S&P Dow Jones Indices (DRAFT, disabled, not encoded)
pin_requirements: The current Dow Jones Islamic Market Indices Methodology document (S&P Dow Jones Indices, spglobal.com), Appendix on Shariah compliance screens: the sector-based screen list; the accounting-based screens with exact thresholds, comparison direction and the trailing averaging window (24 months); the current status of the accounts-receivable screen after the 2026-09 revision; and the methodology's dividend purification treatment.
reason_ar: بوابة التثبيت في الإيشو #169: لا تُشفّر الأرقام إلا من وثيقة منهجية S&P DJI الحالية نفسها. تلك الوثيقة منشورة على spglobal.com ولم يمكن جلبها من بيئة البناء (الوصول محظور). أحدث نسخة قابلة للقراءة من مصدر ثالث تعود إلى مارس 2019 وتسبق مراجعة سبتمبر 2026 التي خفضت الحدود إلى 30%، والملخصات الثانوية لا تؤكد بقاء فحص الذمم المدينة في المنهجية الحالية. هذا الملف يوثق حالة المسودة فقط؛ لا يحتوي أي نسب مشفرة والمحرك لا يحمّله.
reason_en: Issue #169 pin gate: figures may be encoded only from S&P DJI's own current methodology document. That document is published on spglobal.com, which could not be fetched from the build environment (access blocked). The newest third-party-hosted copy that could be read is the March 2019 edition, which predates the September 2026 revision that lowered the limits to 30%, and secondary summaries do not confirm whether the accounts-receivable screen survives in the current methodology. This file records the draft status only: it contains no encoded ratios and the engine does not load it.
secondary_reports_unpinned: The March 2019 DJIM methodology (S&P DJI document, third-party hosted copy) and multiple secondary summaries agree on the pre-revision screens: total debt, cash + interest-bearing securities, and accounts receivable each below 33% of the trailing 24-month average market capitalisation, with a business-activity screen (alcohol, pork, conventional financial services, entertainment, tobacco, weapons and defence) and non-permissible revenue below 5%.

Secondary summaries report that an S&P DJI notice of 2026-08-20 moved the Dow Jones Islamic Market World Index and two related indices to a 30% ceiling on the same 24-month base, effective 2026-09-21; one current summary lists only two financial ratios for the revised DJIM methodology and states it has no separate accounts-receivable ratio. Whether that holds for the whole DJIM family is what the pin must settle.
sources_attempted: https://www.spglobal.com/spdji/en/ (DJIM methodology documents) — fetch blocked in the build environment (2026-11-18); not retried through another route, per policy.

Dow Jones Islamic Market Indices Methodology, March 2019 edition, third-party hosted copy (nbfc.sbmgroup.mu) — readable but stale: predates the September 2026 revision, so it cannot pin current figures.
